event.event_description: The Dravaryn vanguard under Commander Kael Draven advances toward the Eastern Border Fortress of Aetherion, demanding immediate surrender of the crystal reserves.

user_choices.description: Send defensive reinforcements and reinforce the crystal shield.
user_choices.potential_risk: Heavy defensive casualties and resource strain.

user_choices.description: Attempt diplomatic negotiations with Kael Draven directly.
user_choices.potential_risk: Kael might use talks as a tactical distraction.

user_choices.description: Secretly evacuate civilians and sabotage the Aether conduits.
user_choices.potential_risk: Loss of fortress territory and crystal infrastructure.

user_choices.description: Request immediate military intervention from the Velorian Alliance.
user_choices.potential_risk: Veloria will demand dangerous technological concessions.

event.user_choice_selected: Request immediate military intervention from the Velorian Alliance.
event.consequence: Selecting 'Request immediate military intervention from the Velorian Alliance.' altered the narrative course. Aetherion sustained its position, but triggered long-term diplomatic demands from surrounding allies.

consequence.choice_selected: Request immediate military intervention from the Velorian Alliance.

consequence.long_term_impact: The balance of power shifted dramatically across Elyra, creating heightened tension between Aetherion, Veloria, and Dravaryn.
